stock.description: Dekon Food & Agriculture Group functions as a holding company, primarily dedicated to the raising and cultivation of pigs and yellow-feathered broilers. Its diverse subsidiaries are involved in providing an array of products, such as market hogs, breeding swine, piglets, and boar semen. Additionally, they supply yellow-feathered broilers, day-old chicks, and eggs. The group also offers complementary items, including animal feed and other essential ingredients. Hu Wei established the company on September 7, 2011, and its main office is located in Chengdu, China.
